title: Sornio Windows Foundation acceptance record
description: One record per Windows acceptance session. A record only validates when every foundation gate (W-01..W-12) is 'passed'. 'blocked' is reserved for the hardware gates (H-13..H-15), which are then never claimed: a foundation acceptance is not a hardware acceptance. The shipped example in foundation-acceptance.example.json deliberately keeps 'REPLACE' placeholders and therefore does NOT validate - it is a worksheet, not evidence.

commitSha.description: The HEAD the installer was built from. The validator compares it with the checked-out HEAD.

webview2.description: 'absent' or 'installed-by-bundled-installer' is what makes W-02 meaningful. A workstation that already has the runtime cannot exercise the fallback, so the validator rejects a foundation record whose environment.webview2 is 'present'.

schemaBefore.description: This milestone is defined by the schema-12 -> schema-13 upgrade; any other starting schema is a different record.

schemaAfter.description: Must be 13. A record that upgrades to any other version does not describe this milestone.

signatureStatus.description: Observed Authenticode state, e.g. 'unsigned' or 'valid'. Never invent 'signed'.

gates.description: Every gate W-01..W-12 must be 'passed'. Only H-13..H-15 may be 'blocked', and a blocked hardware gate must carry a reason and must not be claimed in hardwareClaimed.

state.description: A foundation gate cannot be 'blocked': a blocked foundation gate means the foundation was not accepted. The validator rejects it even when a reason is supplied.

evidence.description: File names or command transcript names relative to the evidence directory. Empty strings are rejected: a blank row is not evidence.

reason.description: Required when a hardware gate is 'blocked'. The validator enforces this.

hardwareClaimed.description: Must agree with the H-13..H-15 gate states: claiming hardware while the gate is blocked is rejected.

financialParity.description: Snapshot proving the schema-12 -> schema-13 upgrade changed no money. Required: a record without it cannot demonstrate that the upgrade preserved financial state.

nonClaims.description: What this record does NOT establish. The validator requires at least the unsigned-build non-claim and a statement that the hardware gates were not executed.

stockMilli.description: Product id -> milli-unit balance. At least three products must be recorded on both sides of the upgrade, and both sides must record the same product ids.

lastInvoiceNumber.description: The real invoice number observed; 'REPLACE' is rejected.

snapshot.description: Integer-typed financial snapshot. The validator rejects non-integers, placeholders and any drift.
